name: OpenClaw Claude
description: Delegates Anthropic model turns to a local @openclaw/claude-app-server process (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, codex-app-server protocol parity). The server wraps @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk and owns the agent loop, streaming, tools, approvals, and session persistence.
author: BigHat Biosciences

bin.description: Path or command for the openclaw-claude-app-server binary

binArgs.description: Extra CLI args passed to the server

env.description: Extra environment variables injected into the server process

approvalPolicy.description: Codex-shaped approval policy. 'never' bypasses all approval gates (mirrors the legacy bypassPermissions setting). The other values emit per-tool approval requests to the plugin, which currently auto-declines them.

priority.description: Harness priority over the built-in PI harness (higher = preferred)

turnIdleTimeoutMs.description: Idle watchdog: fail the turn if no notification arrives for this long

statePath.description: Path for the on-disk thread persistence file (sessionId → server threadId mapping). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/state/claude-threads.json
